title: Podcast clip
inspired_by: inspired by The Diary of a CEO (@thediaryofaceo)
one_liner: A dark, moody podcast clip: the hook is on screen from the first frame, short captions sit under your chin, a profile card says who you are, and the last line fades to black and white.
best_for: Clips from your own podcast, interview, workshop or Zoom/Riverside chat where one strong opinion carries the whole clip
effort: Medium: rough cut + word timings + one build; one camera works, two people on a call works even better

palette.use: hook boxes, name-label box, ID-card background
hook words and the main speaker's captions
host captions and the name label under the hook
one red word in the hook and in a caption block

pace: Pauses cut tight, 1.1x, ~172 wpm; a new crop every 1.7-3.9 s (median ~2.2 s); captions hard-switch every 1-3 words
signature_moves: Hook frame on frame 0: two faces side by side, a glowing divider and a two-line caps headline on black boxes, both lines locked to the same width, one word in red
A full-screen profile card at about a quarter of the way in: tilted B&W print, your name huge, real role tags stamped in one by one
The emotional beat: the last line fades from colour to black and white while the caption holds
